findings.title: Non-atomic existence check allows duplicate claims and overwrite under concurrency
findings.evidence: The new code checks for existence and then opens the path in write mode, so two callers can both observe the file as absent and one can truncate or overwrite a file created by the other before raising any error.
findings.recommendation: Keep atomic exclusive creation by using open(path, 'x') directly, or use os.open with O_CREAT|O_EXCL and wrap the fd. Do not split the existence check from file creation.
